findings.title: Flex container breaks existing right-floated small-action button
findings.body: Making .small-action a flex container causes its child button's existing float: right rule to be ignored, because float does not apply to flex items. Unless the button is given a flex-aware rule such as margin-left: auto, it will no longer be positioned at the right edge, causing a layout regression in small-action items.

findings.title: align-items mixin omits -moz-box-align
findings.body: The new align-items() mixin emits -webkit-box-align but not -moz-box-align, even though flexbox() emits display: -moz-box. Browsers that fall back to the old Mozilla box model will not receive the requested alignment, so align-items(center) or align-items(baseline) will not work in that fallback path.

findings.title: order mixin uses CSS order values for older 1-based ordinal-group properties
findings.body: order() passes the same value to -webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group, which are 1-based, while the standard order property is 0-based. The current uses with 2 and 3 happen to preserve the intended relative order, but future uses such as order(0) or order(1) will not behave consistently across the prefixed and unprefixed implementations.
